title: Web board: an Inbox page of what needs the user
summary: Spec v1: a board view right after Home, on a project and All projects: open questions, PRs to review, PRs ready to merge, blocked CRs, from a read-only needs_you field of the board topic. Open (a link or the panel), Snooze 1 h, Later 08:00, Discard, kept in the browser; counts, opt-in notification.
